class PointWiseFeedForward(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_units: int, dropout_rate: float, ffn_multiplier: int = 4):
        super().__init__()
        intermediate_units = hidden_units * ffn_multiplier
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(hidden_units, intermediate_units, kernel_size=1)
        self.dropout1 = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(intermediate_units, hidden_units, kernel_size=1)
